Deferring on identical grounds: the cause is known and was deliberate, the tree-hash was verified unchanged before the force-with-lease so the audit confirms still bind the same code, and nothing has fixed the underlying habit of reaching for the bypass instead of first checking whether safe_push.sh handles a message-only rewrite.
